meta.name: clean-user-facing-text
meta.description: Audit and finalize authorized natural-language text meant for readers: strip suspicious invisible Unicode, then rewrite prose while keeping facts, meaning, and the writer's voice. Use when the user asks to clean, humanize, polish, or finalize articles, manuscripts, reports, documentation, emails, product copy, UI text, Markdown, or HTML prose, or when a project rule explicitly requires this workflow. Don't use for code-only tasks or undisclosed authorship evasion; leave code, commands, identifiers, paths, APIs, formulas, citations, required disclosures, and verbatim quotations unchanged.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清洗文中隐藏字符,润色散文同时保留原意与作者风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常在发布前清理和润色文章、报告等文本,想保留原意和作者风格。
copy.tagline_en: Clean hidden Unicode and polish prose while preserving meaning and voice.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit articles and reports before publishing and need to keep the author's tone.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当你请求清洁、润色或定稿文章、邮件、产品文案等面向读者的文本时，Claude 会先移除可疑的不可见 Unicode 字符，再重写散文，同时保留事实、数字、引文和作者原有语气；代码、命令、公式等保持不变，只返回润色结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求清洁、润色或定稿文章、邮件、产品文案等面向读者的文本，或项目规则明确要求此流程时触发。不用于纯代码或未披露的作者身份规避任务。

say.text: 请清理并润色这篇文章，保留我的原意和语气。
say.note: 会先去除不可见字符，再重写散文。

say.text: 这个 Markdown 文件里的散文帮我润色，代码和命令别动。
say.note: 会保护代码，只处理散文部分。

say.text: 帮我定稿这份产品文案，所有事实和数字必须不变。
say.note: 重写时保留全部事实、数字和引文。

howto.what_en: When you ask to clean or polish reader-facing text, Claude strips suspicious invisible Unicode, then rewrites prose keeping facts, numbers, and the writer's voice. Non-prose spans (code, commands, formulas) stay untouched; only the polished result is returned.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to clean, polish, or finalize articles, emails, product copy, or similar prose, or when a project rule requires this workflow. Not for code-only tasks or undisclosed authorship evasion.

say_en.text: Clean and polish this article, keeping my original meaning and tone.
say_en.note: Removes invisible Unicode first, then rewrites prose.

say_en.text: Polish the prose in this Markdown file, but leave code and commands untouched.
say_en.note: Protects code and edits only prose.

say_en.text: Finalize this product copy; all facts and numbers must stay unchanged.
say_en.note: Keeps every fact, number, and quote during rewrite.
